import numpy as np
import control as ctrl
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.optimize import curve_fit
cells:
rng=np.random.RandomState(42)
K_samples=rng.uniform(.8,1.2,20)
T_samples=rng.uniform(.8,1.3,20)
w=np.logspace(-2,2,500)
s=1j*w
G_samples=K_samples[:,None]/(1+T_samples[:,None]*s)
G_nom=1/(1+s)
errors=(G_samples-G_nom)/G_nom
W_data=np.max(abs(errors),axis=0)
def weight_model(w,a,b,c):
    return np.hypot(a*w,b)/np.hypot(w,c)
params,_=curve_fit(weight_model,w,W_data,p0=[.5,.2,1],bounds=([1e-5,1e-5,1e-5],[2,2,20]),maxfev=10000)
a,b,c=params
raw=weight_model(w,a,b,c)
scale=max(1.,float(max(W_data/raw)))*1.05
a,b=a*scale,b*scale
fitted=weight_model(w,a,b,c)
analytic=abs((.5*s+.2)/(.8*s+1))
fit_cover=bool(np.all(fitted>=W_data-1e-12))
analytic_cover=bool(np.all(analytic>=W_data-1e-12))
print('fit_positive',a>0 and b>0 and c>0,'fit_grid_coverage',fit_cover,'analytic_sample_coverage',analytic_cover)
print('fit_parameters',a,b,c,'minimum_grid_ratio',min(fitted/W_data))
print('analytic_DC_HF',.2,.5/.8)
selected_K,selected_T,selected_w=.8,1.3,1.
sel_G=selected_K/(1+1j*selected_w*selected_T)
sel_G0=1/(1+1j*selected_w)
print('default_first_order',abs(sel_G-sel_G0),abs((sel_G-sel_G0)/sel_G0),abs((.5j+.2)/(.8j+1)))
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4))
for response in G_samples:axes[0].semilogx(w,20*np.log10(abs(response)),color='gray',alpha=.3)
axes[0].semilogx(w,20*np.log10(abs(G_nom)),label='nominal')
axes[0].set(xlim=(.01,100),ylim=(-50,10),xlabel='Frequency (rad/s)',ylabel='Magnitude (dB)')
axes[1].semilogx(w,W_data,label='20-sample envelope')
axes[1].semilogx(w,fitted,label='positive stable fit, grid only')
axes[1].semilogx(w,analytic,label='analytic interval bound')
axes[1].set(xlim=(.01,100),ylim=(0,1),xlabel='Frequency (rad/s)',ylabel='Relative error magnitude')
for ax in axes:ax.grid(True);ax.legend()
plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
print('fit_complete')
W_add=np.max(abs(G_samples-G_nom),axis=0)
conversion_residual=float(max(abs(W_add-abs(G_nom)*W_data)))
print('conversion_residual',conversion_residual)
for i in [0,-1]:print('additive_multiplicative',w[i],abs(G_nom[i]),W_add[i],W_data[i])
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4))
axes[0].semilogx(w,W_add,label='additive envelope')
axes[0].set(xlim=(.01,100),ylim=(0,1),xlabel='Frequency (rad/s)',ylabel='Absolute error')
axes[1].semilogx(w,W_data,label='multiplicative envelope')
axes[1].set(xlim=(.01,100),ylim=(0,1),xlabel='Frequency (rad/s)',ylabel='Relative error')
for ax in axes:ax.grid(True);ax.legend()
plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
print('conversion_complete')
m0,b0,k0=1.,.2,1.
wm,wk=.3,.3
rng=np.random.RandomState(42)
m=1+wm*rng.uniform(-1,1,2000)
k=1+wk*rng.uniform(-1,1,2000)
w=np.logspace(-1,2,200);s=1j*w
D0=s*s+.2*s+1
G0=1/D0
G_mc=1/(m[:,None]*s*s+b0*s+k[:,None])
error=abs((G_mc-G0)/G0)
envelope=error.max(axis=0)
rho=(wm*w*w+wk)/abs(D0)
valid=rho<1
upper=np.full_like(w,np.nan)
upper[valid]=rho[valid]/(1-rho[valid])
valid_cover=bool(np.all(envelope[valid]<=upper[valid]+1e-10))
old_cover=bool(np.all(envelope<=rho+1e-10))
print('msd_old_first_order_is_bound',old_cover,'valid_reverse_triangle_covers',valid_cover)
# Build P from physical state-space ports [v_m,v_k,u] -> [acceleration,q,y].
A0=np.array([[0.,1.],[-1.,-.2]])
Bv=np.array([[0.,0.],[-wm,-wk]])
Bu=np.array([[0.],[1.]])
Cz=np.array([[-1.,-.2],[1.,0.]])
Dzv=np.array([[-wm,-wk],[0.,0.]])
Dzu=np.array([[1.],[0.]])
Cy=np.array([[1.,0.]])
max_lft_residual=0.
for dm in [-1.,0.,1.]:
    for dk in [-1.,0.,1.]:
        Delta=np.diag([dm,dk])
        for si in s:
            R=np.linalg.solve(si*np.eye(2)-A0,np.eye(2))
            P11=Cz@R@Bv+Dzv;P12=Cz@R@Bu+Dzu
            P21=Cy@R@Bv;P22=Cy@R@Bu
            Fu=(P22+P21@Delta@np.linalg.solve(np.eye(2)-P11@Delta,P12))[0,0]
            exact=1/((1+wm*dm)*si*si+b0*si+(1+wk*dk))
            max_lft_residual=max(max_lft_residual,abs(Fu-exact))
print('exact_lft_residual_9_corners',max_lft_residual)
# At w=1, dm=dk=1/3 gives m=k=1.1: nominal denominator=.2j, error=0.
# At w=1, dm=1,dk=-1 gives eta=3j: rho=3 and the reverse-triangle bound is inapplicable.
print('rho_at_one',(.3+.3)/.2)
si=.5j
eta=(-.3*.25-.3)/(.75+.1j)
actual=abs(-eta/(1+eta))
print('old_bound_counterexample_at_half',abs(eta),actual)
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4))
for response in G_mc[:50]:axes[0].semilogx(w,abs(response),color='gray',alpha=.2)
axes[0].semilogx(w,abs(G0),label='nominal')
axes[0].set(xlim=(.1,100),ylim=(0,10),xlabel='Frequency (rad/s)',ylabel='Displacement / force')
axes[1].semilogx(w,envelope,label='2000-sample envelope')
axes[1].semilogx(w,rho,label='first-order magnitude, not a bound')
axes[1].semilogx(w,upper,label='rho/(1-rho), only rho<1')
axes[1].set(xlim=(.1,100),ylim=(0,15),xlabel='Frequency (rad/s)',ylabel='Relative error (clipped)')
for ax in axes:ax.grid(True);ax.legend()
plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
print('msd_complete')
A=np.diag([-1.,-2.]);B=np.array([[1.,2.],[0.,1.]])
Cp=np.eye(2);D=np.zeros((2,2))
plant=ctrl.ss(A,B,Cp,D)
w=np.logspace(-2,2,500)
fr=ctrl.frequency_response(plant,w,squeeze=False).frdata
assert fr.shape==(2,2,500)
I=np.eye(2)
rows=[]
for gain in [.5,1.,2.,4.]:
    Kc=np.diag([gain,1.])
    H=Cp@np.linalg.solve(1j*I-A,B)
    Lo=H@Kc;Li=Kc@H
    To=np.linalg.solve((I+Lo).T,Lo.T).T
    Ti=np.linalg.solve((I+Li).T,Li.T).T
    row=[gain,float(np.linalg.svd(To,compute_uv=False)[0]),float(np.linalg.svd(Ti,compute_uv=False)[0]),float(np.linalg.norm(To-Ti))]
    rows.append(row);print('mimo_at_one',row)
    assert max(np.linalg.eigvals(A-B@Kc@Cp).real)<0
sv_o=[];sv_i=[]
Kc=np.diag([2.,1.])
for j in range(len(w)):
    H=fr[:,:,j];Lo=H@Kc;Li=Kc@H
    To=np.linalg.solve((I+Lo).T,Lo.T).T;Ti=np.linalg.solve((I+Li).T,Li.T).T
    sv_o.append(np.linalg.svd(To,compute_uv=False)[0]);sv_i.append(np.linalg.svd(Ti,compute_uv=False)[0])
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,4))
ax.semilogx(w,sv_o,label='output-loop T_O')
ax.semilogx(w,sv_i,label='input-loop T_I')
ax.set(xlim=(.01,100),ylim=(0,2.5),xlabel='Frequency (rad/s)',ylabel='Largest singular value')
ax.legend();ax.grid(True);plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
print('mimo_complete')
# Retain all four exercises; clarify the missing phase information in exercise 2.
s=10j
G0=2/(s+1);Gp=2.4/(s+1)+.1/(s*s+.2*s+100)
print('answer1_resonance',abs(Gp-G0),abs((Gp-G0)/G0))
mag=np.array([.95,1.05,.98,1.02,1.10])
for nominal in [1.,.9]:
    lower=abs(mag/nominal-1);upper=mag/nominal+1
    print('answer2_magnitude_only_bounds',nominal,lower,upper)
print('same_magnitude_opposite_phase_relative_error',abs((-1-1)/1))
for delta in [-1.,0.,1.]:
    for si in [0j,1j,10j]:
        P=np.array([[-.5/(si+1),si/(si+1)],[.5/(si+1),1/(si+1)]])
        Fu=P[1,1]+P[1,0]*delta/(1-P[0,0]*delta)*P[0,1]
        target=(1+.5*delta)/(si+1+.5*delta)
        assert abs(Fu-target)<1e-12
print('answer3_lft_complete')
print('answer4_sample_utilization',1/np.array([1.5,1.1,3.2]))
# SISO coprime factor example; simultaneous scaling cancels and is not multiplicative plant uncertainty.
si=1j;N=1/(si+2);M=(si+1)/(si+2);delta=.2
print('coprime_nominal_wrong_correct',N/M,N*(1+delta)/(M*(1+delta)),N*(1+delta)/M)
# G1=0 and G2=eps/(s-1): small frequency magnitude does not remove an unstable mode.
eps=.1
print('chordal_supremum_only',eps/np.sqrt(1+eps*eps))
# normalized N2=eps/(s+a), M2=(s-1)/(s+a), a=sqrt(1+eps^2).
# Gamma2^* Gamma1 = (s+1)/(s-a): no RHP zero, one RHP pole -> nonzero winding.
print('normalized_graph_cross_RHP_pole',np.sqrt(1+eps*eps),'zeros_minus_poles',-1)
print('all_answers_complete')
